votes.motion: Approve the minutes of March 7, 2022 and March 22, 2022.
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by watters, the above minutes were approved. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the requested variance for 30 Johnson Street: offset to property line for the new well from 50 feet to 21 feet.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the board unanimously approved the requested variance. all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the one-year extension of the septic permit at 21 West Townsend Road.

votes.motion: Approve the variance for 36 Pearl Street (system 65 feet from the on-site well instead of 100 feet from surrounding wells).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by fortin and second by watters, the board voted to approve the variance. all in favor.

votes.motion: On the request for a bedroom deed restriction at 123 Chase Road (limit of five bedrooms, new duplex construction): roll call, with all four members voting No; the request was denied.
